notes: §1985:X.4.4.3 SR1: 'The availability of the report description entry is dependent on whether the Report Writer module is supported'; the compiler supports Report Writer (docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 5, A.4.11), so at 85 the RD must be available with its IPC GLOBAL clause, which makes 'LINE-COUNTER and PAGE-COUNTER are global names' (§1985:X.4.4.4 GR1). The grammar's reportDescriptionEntry parses RD [IS GLOBAL] CODE/CONTROL/PAGE, and ReportSectionBinder.BindReportSection / BindReportDescriptionClauses bind it at every edition with the 1985 CODE rule (COBOL2713). Probes at --std 85: RD RPT IS GLOBAL CODE "QZ" CONTROLS ARE FINAL W-KEY PAGE LIMIT 10 LINES HEADING 1 FIRST DETAIL 3 LAST DETAIL 8 FOOTING 9, INITIATE in the outer program, GENERATE twice and LINE-COUNTER/PAGE-COUNTER read in a contained program (LC 3 PC 1) writes QZHEAD, blank, QZA -  5 twice and the FINAL footing QZTOT - 10; without GLOBAL the contained program's GENERATE is refused COBOL1757 and its counters COBOL2729; GLOBAL or PAGE written twice COBOL2423; CODE "Q" and CODE identifier COBOL2713; PRESENT WHEN (2002) COBOL0900. Witness: an RD with one DETAIL group generates at 85.

next.reason: 1985: "The availability of the report description entry is dependent on whether the Report Writer module is supported"; 2023: "13.14.3 gives report description entry rules (SR-13.14.3-1, -2) with no dependency on a Report Writer module". 2023 specifies the report description entry without tying its availability to a supported Report Writer module. No candidate keeps the module-dependency rule.
